fullPassage: A study by Eurofound found that young people who were working remotely reported more difficulties in managing their workload than older colleagues. Moreover, many young people began their careers working remotely during the pandemic, unlike those in older generations who had many years to establish interpersonal connections and embed themselves in the organizational culture in an in-person job. A survey by Prospects found that almost half of students and graduates in the United Kingdom found it difficult to work from home during the pandemic due to a lack of suitable workspace or distractions. While young people may struggle long-term with remote work, perhaps more of a hybrid model where they can work from home part of the time and work onsite other times, would work well for them. But it may not be that they need a formal hybrid structure with specific days of the week designated for working remotely but instead a fluid option that allows them, if possible, depending on the job role, to choose their day-to-day work location.

A survey by Prospects found that almost half of students and graduates in the United Kingdom found it difficult to work from home during the pandemic due to a lack of suitable workspace or distractions. While young people may struggle long-term with remote work, perhaps more of a (B)[hybrid / traditional] model where they can work from home part of the time and work onsite other times, would work well for them. But it may not be that they need a formal hybrid structure with specific days of the week designated for working remotely but instead a (C)[fluid / rigid] option that allows them, if possible, depending on the job role, to choose their day-to-day work location.

det.analysis:
① remotely — interpersonal — suitable: 세 단어 모두 원문 그대로 ←정답

questions.passage: A study by Eurofound found that young people who were working remotely reported more difficulties in managing their ①<u>workload</u> than older colleagues. Moreover, many young people began their careers working remotely during the pandemic, unlike those in older generations who had many years to establish interpersonal connections and embed themselves in the organizational culture in an in-person job. A survey by Prospects found that almost half of students and graduates in the United Kingdom found it difficult to work from home during the pandemic due to a lack of suitable workspace or distractions. While young people may ②<u>thrive</u> long-term with remote work, perhaps more of a hybrid model where they can work from home part of the time and work onsite other times, would work well for them. But it may not be that they need a formal hybrid structure with specific days of the week ③<u>designated</u> for working remotely but instead a fluid option that allows them, if possible, depending on the job role, to choose their ④<u>day-to-day</u> work location.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ①업무량 ②번성하다(→원문: struggle 힘들어하다) ③지정된 ④일상적인
det.analysis:
① workload: 업무량 관리의 어려움 — 문맥상 적절
② thrive: 번성하다 → 원문은 struggle(힘들어하다). 젊은이들이 원격 근무에서 장기적으로 번성한다는 것은 문맥과 반대 ←정답
③ designated: 지정된 — 특정 요일이 원격 근무로 지정된다는 문맥에 적절
④ day-to-day: 일상적인 — 일상적 근무 장소를 선택한다는 문맥에 적절
det.tip: struggle long-term with remote work(원격 근무에 장기적으로 힘들어하다). thrive(번성하다)로 바꾸면 글의 논지와 정반대.

questions.passage: A study by Eurofound found that young people who were working remotely reported more difficulties in managing their workload than older colleagues. Moreover, many young people began their careers working remotely during the pandemic, unlike those in older generations who had many years to establish interpersonal connections and ①<u>embed</u> themselves in the organizational culture in an in-person job. A survey by Prospects found that almost half of students and graduates in the United Kingdom found it difficult to work from home during the pandemic due to a lack of ②<u>suitable</u> workspace or distractions. While young people may struggle long-term with remote work, perhaps more of a hybrid model where they can work from home part of the time and work onsite other times, would work well for them. But it may not be that they need a formal hybrid structure with specific days of the week designated for working remotely but instead a ③<u>fixed</u> option that allows them, if possible, depending on the job role, to choose their ④<u>day-to-day</u> work location.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ①정착시키다 ②적절한 ③고정된(→원문: fluid 유연한) ④일상적인
det.analysis:
① embed: 조직 문화에 자신을 정착시키다 — 문맥상 적절
② suitable: 적절한 작업 공간 — 문맥상 적절
③ fixed: 고정된 → 원문은 fluid(유연한). 유연한 선택지가 아닌 고정된 선택지라 하면 day-to-day 근무 장소를 선택한다는 뒤 맥락과 모순 ←정답
④ day-to-day: 일상적인 근무 장소 — 문맥상 적절
det.tip: a fluid option(유연한 선택지). fixed(고정된)로 바꾸면 유연하게 장소를 선택한다는 맥락과 모순.

questions.passage: A study by Eurofound found that young people who were working remotely reported more difficulties in managing their workload than older colleagues. A survey by Prospects found that almost half of students and graduates in the United Kingdom found it difficult to work from home during the pandemic due to a ①<u>surplus</u> of suitable workspace or distractions. While young people may struggle long-term with remote work, perhaps more of a ②<u>hybrid</u> model where they can work from home part of the time and work onsite other times, would work well for them. But it may not be that they need a formal hybrid structure with specific days of the week ③<u>designated</u> for working remotely but instead a fluid option that allows them, if possible, depending on the job role, to choose their ④<u>day-to-day</u> work location.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ①잉여(→원문: lack 부족) ②혼합형 ③지정된 ④일상적인
det.analysis:
① surplus: 잉여, 과잉 → 원문은 lack(부족). 적절한 작업 공간의 잉여 때문에 재택이 어렵다는 것은 논리적으로 모순 ←정답
② hybrid: 혼합형 모델 — 문맥상 적절
③ designated: 지정된 — 특정 요일이 원격 근무로 지정, 적절
④ day-to-day: 일상적인 근무 장소 — 문맥상 적절
det.tip: a lack of suitable workspace(적절한 작업 공간의 부족). surplus(잉여)로 바꾸면 재택이 어렵다는 이유와 모순.

det.korean: 집에서 일부, 현장에서 일부 근무하는 ___ 모델이 잘 맞을 것이다.
det.analysis:
① remote: 원격 — 집에서만 근무하는 모델이므로 빈칸 뒤 설명(집+현장)과 불일치
② onsite: 현장 — 현장에서만 근무하는 모델이므로 빈칸 뒤 설명과 불일치

④ permanent: 영구적인 — 근무 형태가 아닌 기간을 설명하는 단어
det.tip: hybrid model — 집에서 일부 시간, 현장에서 나머지 시간을 근무하는 혼합형 모델.

det.korean: 공식적 구조가 아닌, 일상적 근무 장소를 스스로 선택할 수 있는 ___ 선택지가 필요하다.
det.analysis:
① strict: 엄격한 — formal과 같은 맥락이라 대비 안 됨
② mandatory: 의무적인 — formal과 같은 맥락이라 대비 안 됨
③ temporary: 일시적인 — 문맥과 무관
④ fluid: 유동적인 — 공식적 구조에 대비되는 유연한 선택지 ←정답

questions.passage:
(A) Many young people began their careers working remotely, unlike those who had years to embed themselves in the organizational <u>culture</u> in an in-person job.

(B) The scientist grew a <u>culture</u> of bacteria in the laboratory to test the new antibiotic's effectiveness.
questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)의 밑줄 친 culture가 의미하는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) organizational culture = 조직 문화 / (B) a culture of bacteria = 배양(균)
det.analysis:
① (A) 배양 — (B) 문화: (A)에서 organizational culture는 조직의 관습·가치관을 뜻하므로 '배양'은 부적절
② (A) 문화 — (B) 배양: 두 문맥 모두 정확 ←정답
③ (A) 문화 — (B) 문명: (B)에서 세균을 '문명'이라 할 수 없음
④ (A) 교양 — (B) 문화: (A)의 organizational culture는 '교양'이 아님
det.tip: culture는 다의어: (A) 조직의 관습/가치관(문화), (B) 실험실에서 세균을 키우는 행위(배양).

det.analysis:
① extract: 추출하다 — 반대 의미
② expose: 노출하다 — 다른 의미
③ observe: 관찰하다 — 다른 의미
④ embed: 단단히 박다, 정착시키다 — 영영 정의와 정확히 일치 ←정답
det.tip: embed는 본문에서 'embed themselves in the organizational culture'(조직 문화에 자신을 정착시키다)로 사용되었다.

questions.passage: A study by Eurofound found that young people who were working remotely reported more __________ in managing their workload than older colleagues. (difficult)
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: difficult(형용사: 어려운) → difficulties(명사: 어려움들)
det.analysis: more __________(difficult) in managing — 형용사 more 뒤에 명사가 필요. difficult(형용사)를 명사형 difficulties로 변환. 복수형인 이유는 다양한 어려움들을 의미.
det.tip: reported more difficulties — 더 많은 어려움들을 보고했다. difficult → difficulty(명사) → difficulties(복수).

questions.passage: Many young people began their careers working remotely during the pandemic, unlike those in older generations who had many years to establish interpersonal connections and embed themselves in the __________ culture in an in-person job. (organize)
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: organize(동사: 조직하다) → organizational(형용사: 조직의)
det.analysis: the __________(organize) culture — 명사 culture를 수식하는 형용사가 필요. organize(동사)를 형용사형 organizational로 변환.
det.tip: organizational culture — 조직 문화. organize → organization(명사) → organizational(형용사).

questions.passage: A study by Eurofound found that young people who were working remotely reported more difficulties in managing their workload than older colleagues. Moreover, many young people began their careers working remotely during the pandemic, unlike those in older generations who had many years to establish interpersonal connections and embed themselves in the organizational culture in an in-person job. A survey by Prospects found that almost half of students and graduates in the United Kingdom found it difficult to work from home during the pandemic due to a lack of suitable workspace or __________. While young people may struggle long-term with remote work, perhaps more of a hybrid model where they can work from home part of the time and work onsite other times, would work well for them. But it may not be that they need a formal hybrid structure with specific days of the week designated for working remotely but instead a fluid option that allows them, if possible, depending on the job role, to choose their day-to-day work location.

det.korean: 적절한 작업 공간의 부족이나 ___ 때문에 재택이 어려웠다.
det.analysis:
① opportunities: 기회 — 재택 어려움의 원인이 아님
② regulations: 규정 — 본문에 언급 없음
③ distractions: 방해 요소 — 적절한 작업 공간 부족과 함께 재택 어려움의 원인 ←정답
④ promotions: 승진 — 문맥과 무관
det.tip: a lack of suitable workspace or distractions — 적절한 작업 공간 부족이나 방해 요소.

questions.passage: A study by Eurofound found that young people who were working remotely reported more difficulties in managing their workload than older colleagues. But it may not be that they need a formal hybrid structure with specific days of the week designated for working remotely but instead a fluid option that allows them, if possible, depending on __________, to choose their day-to-day work location.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 가능하다면, ___에 따라 일상적 근무 장소를 선택할 수 있는 유연한 선택지.
det.analysis:
① the job role: 직무 역할 — 근무 장소 선택이 직무에 따라 달라진다는 원문 맥락 ←정답
② the weather: 날씨 — 근무 장소 결정과 무관한 요소
③ their salary: 급여 — 본문에 언급 없음
④ the pandemic: 팬데믹 — 과거 상황이지 현재 선택 기준이 아님
det.tip: depending on the job role — 직무 역할에 따라. 근무 장소의 유연성이 직무 성격에 따라 결정된다는 맥락.
